export const metadata = {
  title: "Environment variables",
  description: "Every variable the app reads, what it is for, and where to get its value.",
}

Declared in `.env.example`. Never commit a filled-in `.env`; `.gitignore` already excludes
it.

## Required to run at all

| Variable | What it is |
|---|---|
| `DATABASE_URL` | Runtime connection. Pooled. Append `?pgbouncer=true` when going through pgBouncer. |
| `DIRECT_URL` | Direct connection, used by migrations only. Bypasses the pooler. |
| `AUTH_SECRET` | Signs session tokens. Generate a long random string. |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL` | The app's own origin. Used to build links in emails. |

<Callout type="warning">
`DIRECT_URL` on Supabase resolves to an IPv6-only host. On an IPv4-only network,
migrations fail with `P1001` while the app itself runs fine through the pooled
`DATABASE_URL`. See [troubleshooting](/docs/developers/troubleshooting).
</Callout>

## Email

| Variable | What it is |
|---|---|
| `AUTH_RESEND_KEY` | Resend API key. Without it no mail is sent, including magic links. |
| `EMAIL_FROM` | Sender address. Defaults to `noreply@deltechmun.in`. |
| `EMAIL_REDIRECT_TO` | Staging sink. Every message goes here instead, with the real recipient in the subject. |

## Payments

| Variable | What it is |
|---|---|
| `RAZORPAY_KEY_ID` | Public key id. |
| `RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET` | Secret key. Server only. |
| `RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | Verifies inbound webhook signatures. Without it, webhooks are rejected. |

UPI details are configured in the admin console, not here.

## Realtime

| Variable | What it is |
|---|---|
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` | Project URL. Quiz realtime only. |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` | Publishable key. Quiz realtime only. |

Both are public by design. Supabase is used here for **realtime and as the Postgres host**,
not for auth and not for data access.

## Storage

| Variable | What it is |
|---|---|
| `S3_BUCKET`, `S3_REGION` | Bucket and region. |
| `S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID`, `S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` | Credentials. Server only, never exposed. |
| `S3_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` | Public origin uploaded files are served from. |
| `S3_ENDPOINT` | For S3-compatible providers that are not AWS. |

Unset means blog image upload throws a typed "not configured" error. Everything else works.

## Integrations and jobs

| Variable | What it is |
|---|---|
| `CRON_SECRET` | Bearer token the three cron routes require. |
| `GFORM_SHARED_SECRET` | Header secret for the Google Form webhook. |
| `SHEET_SYNC_SECRET` | Authenticates the outbound sheet mirror. |
| `GROQ_API_KEY`, `GROQ_MODEL` | AI import mapping. Optional. Model defaults to `llama-3.3-70b-versatile`. |
| `ADMIN_EMAIL` | Seeded admin account. |

## Read by code but not in `.env.example`

| Variable | What it is |
|---|---|
| `DATABASE_POOL_MAX` | Postgres pool size. |
| `ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE_SEED` | Must be `1` for the staging seed to run. |
| `NEXTAUTH_SECRET` | Legacy fallback for `AUTH_SECRET`. |
| `RECRUITMENT_DB_CHECKS` | Enables database-backed recruitment checks. |
| `QUIZ_LOAD_*` | Options for the quiz load-test script. |

Platform-supplied: `NODE_ENV`, `VERCEL`, `VERCEL_ENV`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_VERCEL_URL`,
`VERCEL_PROJECT_PRODUCTION_URL`.

## Rules

- Anything named `NEXT_PUBLIC_` is **in the browser bundle**. Never put a secret behind that
  prefix.
- Credentials are read lazily, so a missing key throws when the feature is used rather than
  at boot. That is what lets CI build with dummy values.
